Rehab_assessment.d01_raw_data: per-sample 81 npy, <movementID 000-026>_<sensorID 1/2/3>.npy; sensor1 (S1/S3) 12ch pitch/yaw/roll/ax/ay/az/mx/my/mz/wx/wy/wz, sensor2 (S2/S4) 13ch (含 pitch2-pitch1), sensor3 (S5) 5ch (pitch3/pitch3-pitch1/f1/f12/f_all); raw N varies (~140 typical)
Rehab_assessment.d02_processed_data: same structure, N fixed = 150 (moving avg + zero-mean + linear interp)
Rehab_assessment.Label.npy: shape (222, 27) int64 CONFIRMED — 康复治疗师 FM 评分 222 samples x 27 movements (临床标签齐备)

Rehab_exercise.structure: 16 training movements (movementID 000-015) x 2 sensor configs = 32 npy (d01 raw + d02 processed)
Rehab_exercise.shape: (d x 880 x 6) float64, d = per-movement sample count (e.g. movement 000 = 232 samples), 880 = standardized signal length; sensor1 = 6ch dual-IMU pitch/yaw/roll (S1+S2 或 S3+S4), sensor2 = 6ch (f1-f5 + pitch3, S5 力传感器)
